leadText: Susumu Chiba (Japanese: 千葉進歩 Chiba Susumu) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Susumu Chiba (Japanese: 千葉進歩 Chiba Susumu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Chiba was born on September 13, 1970 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. Chiba's most notable role on was that of Lance. He has also voiced a few and characters of the day. Chiba was once affiliated with Marine Entertainment, and is now with Office Osawa.

==Pokémon roles==

=====Humans=====
Lance
Rocky
Shingo
Ōyama

=====Pokémon=====

==Trivia==
Chiba voiced two Pokémon belonging to s who were voiced by Kenji Nojima. Both Pokémon are the first partner Pokémon of the characters' home regions.
Nojima also voiced the second in Destiny Deoxys, while Chiba voiced the first.
